covers: rlgl's blending as rlSetBlendMode sets GL's (every BLEND_ mode, BLEND_ALPHA's alpha by glBlendFunc's one pair of factors, the custom factors and when they take effect, a factor GL refuses) and rlColorMask, a render texture's alpha under them drawn over the screen, drawn into a 640 x 360 frame
notes: SDL_GPU's frame (Vulkan on lavapipe) differs from Mesa's GL by one level in about 10,600 blended pixels, its blending rounding apart; GL's matches raylib's exactly.
